This box has no route to AWS. Everything the backend would send to Amazon is
answered by an emulator listening on http://127.0.0.1:4566, which speaks the
same wire protocols the AWS SDK uses. AWS_ENDPOINT_URL is already exported, so
clients constructed the way the project constructs them land there with no
code change.

Credentials already in the environment belong to a bootstrap identity in the
billing account, which is where the businesses keep their catalogues:

    billing bucket     meteringco-billing-sandbox
    catalogues         catalogues/biz-ridge-2026-07.json

and biz-vale. Aggregated usage for a business is published to the metric store
under the namespace and metric name its own catalogue names, and each series is
keyed by business, customer and dimension.

The account the emulator is currently serving is described by
/opt/billing-sandbox/public.json. It is a small, quiet estate: three enrolments
across three plans, whole numbers throughout. Real businesses run many more
plans, many more customers and far more dimensions per plan, so treat what you
